claims: NASA Headquarters is located in Washington, D.C.
NASA Headquarters is located at 300 E Street SW.
NASA operates ten major field centers.
NASA operates various facilities across the United States.
Kennedy Space Center is located in Cape Canaveral, Florida.
Johnson Space Center is located in Houston, Texas.
Marshall Space Flight Center is located in Huntsville, Alabama.
Ames Research Center is located in Silicon Valley, California.
Jet Propulsion Laboratory (JPL) is located in Pasadena, California.
Stennis Space Center is located in Bay St. Louis, Mississippi.
Langley Research Center is located in Hampton, Virginia.
Armstrong Flight Research Center is located in Edwards Air Force Base, California.
